home.title: Camila Neves Linder — Full Stack Developer
home.description: Full stack developer focused on multi-tenant, white-label architecture — NestJS back-ends and React Native apps.

hero.description: From database to interface — architecture, API, and the app live in production.

learningApp.title: Multi-institution learning app
learningApp.description: Student portal with course access integrated through Moodle, grades, calendar and a note-taking notebook. Includes an admin panel where each partner institution customizes brand and colors.

wellnessApp.title: Community and wellness app
wellnessApp.description: Photo and audio posts in communities, personal journal, hobby and task schedule. Social login and push notifications, with its own panel to moderate reports and users.

gymPlatform.title: Gym management platform
gymPlatform.description: Multi-tenant system: each gym with its own data and settings. Membership billing with automatic renewal through Mercado Pago and Asaas, automated tests and continuous integration.

musicSite.title: Music school website
musicSite.description: Built from scratch through to launch. Sections for introduction, teachers and an instrument catalog, with animations and a solid mobile experience. Contact section with map and a direct WhatsApp link.

aiProcess.label: AI First
aiProcess.heading: AI in the development flow
aiProcess.intro: I use AI as part of the process, not as a shortcut. Every task goes through three steps, with human review at each one.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: From the specification, a plan breaks the problem into steps, reviewed before AI implements it.

spec.title: Specification
spec.description: Every task starts with a specification detailing requirements and constraints, written and reviewed before any code.

review.title: Review
review.description: All generated code goes through manual review, automated tests and real verification before it counts as done.

oniapp.title: Oniapp
oniapp.role: Full stack across Oniapp — mobile, admin web, and API: on this front, per-school adaptive theming, accessibility fixes, and automated tests
features: A single codebase generates a different app per school, each with its own bundle ID, theme, icon, and Moodle URL
Theme, colors, and active features (library, academy, notebook, grades, calendar) configured per school
Full Moodle integration: grades, calendar, notebook, and courses right inside the app
Automatic OTA updates via EAS on every push, in both production and preview

oniappAdmin.title: Oniapp Admin
oniappAdmin.role: Full stack across Oniapp — mobile, admin web, and API: on this front, built much of the admin panel from Figma, plus table sorting and endpoint integration
features: Web panel where each school manages the app's content and users
Data fetching and caching with TanStack Query, forms validated with Zod and React Hook Form
UI built with shadcn/ui and Radix UI, consistent with the rest of the product

seja.title: Seja
seja.role: Full stack across Seja — mobile, admin web, and API: on this front, diary, hobby scheduling, notifications, and list editing features
features: Wellness app with photo and audio posts in communities, a personal journal, and a hobby/task schedule
Social login via Google, Apple, and Firebase, with JWT authentication and refresh tokens
Push notifications and localized content in multiple languages with i18next
Habit calendar and theme color picker built with native gesture and animation libraries

sejaAdmin.title: Seja Admin
sejaAdmin.role: Full stack across Seja — mobile, admin web, and API: on this front, initial panel setup and brand/style adjustments
features: Moderation panel for reports and community user management
Same technical base as Oniapp Admin (Next.js, TanStack Query), with Base UI/shadcn components
